items.attention: Power Packs One Piece Platinum Series 1 GameStop Trading Card Products Sweepstakes
items.instructions: Hand-print required entrant information on a 3×5 card and mail one card per #10 envelope with proper postage. Follow the official rules exactly.
items.notes: US-only sweepstakes. Current rules page verified.

items.entryLimit: 1 submission form per envelope; 1 eligible product per envelope
items.address: Topps Access Program, PO Box 1732, Allen, TX 75013
items.instructions: Download and print the official submission form, then hand-print name, complete return address, and full eligible product name from the checklist. Product must display NPN or Topps Access designation.
items.prize: Random card from the eligible product pool; pool may include checklist cards, parallels, inserts and short prints. Certain highly limited cards such as 1/1s are excluded.
items.notes: US/Canada except Quebec. Drawings occur on/about 60 days after release. While supplies last.

items.instructions: Use the official Upper Deck NPN portal and follow the rules shown for each current sweepstakes.
items.notes: Portal exists and is actively hosted; individual offers must be extracted/verified.
